product_metadata.title: Great American Distributors Hearth Slice Fireplace Rug - Log Cabin Decor, Kitchen Carpet, Accent Rug, for Wood Floors, Fire Resistant Mat, Nature Scene, Bear 2'2" x 3'3" (Beige/Green)
features: CLASSIC HEARTH SLICE ACCENT RUG: Add a touch of elegance to your home with our classic half-moon shaped fireplace accent rug
FIRE RESISTANT FIBERS: Our classic slice rug is thoughtfully designed with flame resistant materials, making it great for log cabins or fireplace areas
STAIN AND FADE RESISTANT: Each rug is woven from naturally stain, soil and fade resistant materials and is made to last for years
MADE FOR HIGH TRAFFIC AREAS: Woven and crafted with the highest quality 100% polypropylene fibers which are soft yet stand up to high traffic

PROTECTS YOUR FLOORS: Our accent rug helps protect surfaces such as wood, brick, tile, or linoleum flooring, which makes it a great choice for log cabin decor, your winter vacation rental, or your living room at home
